paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Comparison of the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth vs. generated answers: Pop_GT vs. Pop_Ge, and RPop_GT vs. RPop_Ge.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and two types of answers—ground-truth (Pop_GT) and generated (Pop_Ge)—as well as their respective reverse correlations (RPop_GT and RPop_Ge) across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the three domains, arranged in the order shown, with no explicit sorting or grouping indicated. The vertical axis, labeled "Correlation," ranges from 0 to 0.7 and is marked with linearly spaced intervals of 0.1, representing the correlation coefficient. The chart displays four distinct bar types, each corresponding to a different answer type as indicated by the legend: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (hatched orange), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (hatched blue). Within each domain, the bars are arranged side by side, indicating a direct comparison of the four correlation values. In the "Movies" category, the correlation values are approximately 0.2 for Pop_GT, 0.1 for Pop_Ge, 0.35 for RPop_GT, and 0.65 for RPop_Ge. In the "Songs" category, the values are approximately 0.3 for Pop_GT, 0.1 for Pop_Ge, 0.5 for RPop_GT, and 0.7 for RPop_Ge. In the "Basketball" category, the values are approximately 0.1 for Pop_GT, 0.1 for Pop_Ge, 0.15 for RPop_GT, and 0.2 for RPop_Ge. No bars are visually emphasized or highlighted beyond their standard representation.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, while the vertical axis, labeled "Correlation," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays four distinct bar types, each representing a different correlation metric: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (hatched orange), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (hatched blue), as indicated by the legend in the top right. For each domain, four bars are grouped together, with Pop_GT and RPop_GT bars appearing taller than their corresponding Pop_Ge and RPop_Ge counterparts. Specifically, for Movies, Pop_GT correlates at approximately 0.22, Pop_Ge at approximately 0.11, RPop_GT at approximately 0.35, and RPop_Ge at approximately 0.63. For Songs, Pop_GT correlates at approximately 0.30, Pop_Ge at approximately 0.10, RPop_GT at approximately 0.50, and RPop_Ge at approximately 0.70. For Basketball, Pop_GT correlates at approximately 0.08, Pop_Ge at approximately 0.08, RPop_GT at approximately 0.15, and RPop_Ge at approximately 0.22. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the domains. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart compares the correlation between ChatGPT’s QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three domains—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—using two distinct correlation metrics: Pop_GT versus Pop_Ge, and RPop_GT versus RPop_Ge. The horizontal axis displays the three domains in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents the correlation value, scaled linearly from 0 to 0.7 with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The legend indicates four distinct bar types: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (orange with diagonal hatching), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (blue with diagonal hatching). For each domain, four bars are grouped side-by-side, representing the respective correlation values for each metric. In the “Movies” category, the Pop_GT bar reaches approximately 0.2, the Pop_Ge bar is slightly lower at around 0.1, the RPop_GT bar is approximately 0.35, and the RPop_Ge bar is approximately 0.62. In the “Songs” category, the Pop_GT bar is approximately 0.3, the Pop_Ge bar is approximately 0.1, the RPop_GT bar is approximately 0.5, and the RPop_Ge bar is approximately 0.7. In the “Basketball” category, the Pop_GT bar is approximately 0.05, the Pop_Ge bar is approximately 0.07, the RPop_GT bar is approximately 0.12, and the RPop_Ge bar is approximately 0.2. The bars are not sorted by height, and no visual highlighting or special formatting is applied to any particular bar.
